blocks.content: Prioritize high-yield topics and master core concepts through focused revision.

rows: Created by an Act of Parliament

items: Questions on Constitutional Articles and Amendments are repeatedly asked in match-the-following format.
Pay close attention to chronological sequences of major historical events and policies.
Distinguish clearly between body types: Statutory, Constitutional, and Executive bodies.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Direct factual questions in preliminary exams are frequently framed around core definitions, articles, and key dates.
Elimination technique works best when fundamental concepts and timelines are clearly memorized.
Prioritize high-yield topics such as Constitutional Amendments, Important Committees, and National Schemes.
Regular revision using concise notes significantly boosts recall speed and accuracy during the exam.
